notes: Ships at app/src/main/assets/task_templates.json. Editable in-app via Settings > Task Templates;
user edits are written to filesDir/task_templates_user.json and merged over these defaults, so an
app update never clobbers Gordon's changes.
Fields: phase (JobPhase enum), title, hours (estimate, nullable), milestone (default false),
Hour estimates assume a 2-person crew on a typical Durham Region detached home and are starting
points only - they are editable per job after the template is applied.
Ontario-specific items (ESA notification, building permit, HRV balancing) are included because
omitting them is how contractors get caught at final inspection.
